b: Seal one pair of your piles that adds up to exactly 7, and another pair that adds up to exactly 11.
Do both and the duel is yours.
Only the top card of a pile counts. Cards beneath are hidden — even from you.
The four 13s are Forces: Flare, Overgrowth, Eclipse and Bramble. They have no value.
You hold 4 cards. Cast every one, onto any pile — yours or your opponent's.
Cover puts a card on top. Tuck slips it hidden beneath the top card.
Then end your turn and draw back up to 4.
A Force covering a pile blasts it away — every card in it goes to the Spent pile.
A Force tucked beneath does nothing... until that pile is blasted later.
A Force may start an empty pile, but it can't be left on top when your turn ends.
At the end of your turn, any two of your piles that add to 7 or 11 seal automatically. An empty pile counts as 0.
Sealed piles are frozen — except to a Force, which can shatter one and free its partner.
Never end a turn with an empty pile of your own, unless it just sealed.
